paper_title: Predicting mortality from AI-based cardiac volumes, mass, and coronary calcium on chest CT
prediction_task: All-cause and cardiovascular mortality prediction from automated chest CT measurements

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Authors need to use cutoff values from NLST and apply to two independent cohorts, performing same analyses individually. The sole usage of quantiles in each cohort is insufficient — must show actual transferable cut-off values exist.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Applied NLST-derived cutoffs to independent cohorts showing consistent risk stratification.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Statistical analysis needs improvement: p-values not adjusted for multiple comparisons. Stepwise elimination lacks adjustment for known confounders (sex, hypertension, dyslipidemia). Must show model works in stratified analyses for young participants and non-smokers.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added multiple comparison correction and consistent confounder adjustment across all cohorts.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Bland-Altman plots show >100% variation in smaller volumes (<100mL). How many patients change risk groups between T0 and T1? This has huge clinical impact and could lead to major misclassifications and potentially harm.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added reclassification analysis showing proportion changing risk groups and clinical impact assessment.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: The model should be uploaded to an open-access repository, not only available on reasonable request, as this limits reproducibility.

CAC and structural results are so confounded by age, sex, smoking, diabetes that there seems little value in non-risk-adjusted results. ROC for clinical models should be in main figure, not supplementary.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Moved clinical model ROC to main Figure 6 and de-emphasized unadjusted results.

reviewer_strengths.text: Excellent and thorough job in responding to input. Authors have adequately addressed concerns with extensive revisions.
